notes.title: Ver. 1.0.3
notes.content:
Update Details:
- Save data compatibility between Nintendo Switch™ and Steam (cross-save feature) has been added.

When uploading data from your Nintendo Switch system, data on the Steam Cloud will be overwritten and any progress on Steam will be lost.

Furthermore, the following will not be carried over:
- Options settings
- Language settings
- Dialogue text that has been edited in chat settings
- Downloadable content

notes.title: Patch notes 2/24/20
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Daemon X Machina.
Build Number: 4696025

This update addresses the following issues:
-Voice language reverts to English upon restarting the game even if previously set to Japanese
-Gargoyle statue cannot be destroyed at high frame rates

[i]If you are experiencing a "UE4 Fatal Error" crash and use an AMD graphics card, please update your graphics driver. We've found that this solves the issue for most people. If you've tried this and are still receiving the error, please email us with details at support@xseedgames.com[/i]
